summary: NewGenIvf Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board-approved reverse stock split at a ratio of 1-for-3. The split affects all shares and takes effect September 1, 2026, reducing outstanding Class A shares from 6,307,870 to approximately 2,102,623. No shareholder approval is required under BVI law. No fractional shares will be issued; eligible shareholders will receive a full share. Options and warrants will be adjusted accordingly. The ticker remains NIVF with a new CUSIP. This is a corporate action to meet listing standards, not a special situation; watch for post-split trading and potential compliance implications.
